name: fibroblast growth factor 9

function.text: FGF9 encodes fibroblast growth factor 9. Annotated molecular activities include growth factor activity and fibroblast growth factor receptor binding. It participates in signal transduction and neurogenesis.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to multiple synostoses syndrome (autosomal dominant); multiple synostoses syndrome 3 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
